integrity: The general statement is proved symbolically from the published bouquet-model classification; finite enumeration is used only to verify the first auxiliary counts and sample model multiplicities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to ranks \(k^2-d\) with \(k\ge d+1\).
No closed form or asymptotic for the auxiliary counts \(b_e\) is claimed.
The stated stabilization threshold is sufficient and is not claimed optimal for every deficit.
title: Near-square stabilization of minimal finite bouquet models
